preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
The number of SWAG Traits n is between 1 and 100, inclusive, for each test case.
The size of each SWAG Trait ki is between 1 and 100, inclusive.
Each element in a SWAG Trait is a positive integer less than or equal to 1000.

postconditions.expression: RK_swag_level + RG_swag_level = sum(all elements in all SWAG Traits)
postconditions.description: The total sum of all elements in all SWAG Traits is the sum of the SWAG levels of RK and RG.
Both RK's and RG's SWAG levels are non-negative integers.
RK has the first turn and both players play optimally.
RK aims to maximize his SWAG level, and RG aims to minimize RK's SWAG level.
